_readme: Automotive-components office and staff dining floor, Noida. Source deck exports are NOT committed (public repo).

The deck PDF holds each slide as one flattened 1600x1000 bitmap whose footer names the client, so every source here is the render area only, cropped at 42,192 996x664 (plan: 42,322 1516x138; mood board: 42,156 1128x750). The footer never enters a source file.

Client marks: wordmark on the feature wall in the first-floor waiting (p12), main office (p13), cubicles (p14) and dining hall (p26); wordmark on the display board in cabin 03 (p15); wordmark on the uniforms in the handwash mural (p28); wordmark on the central stair wall (p31). p12, p13, p14 and p26 are patched with wall sampled from directly above (or below) the mark. p15, p28 and p31 are dropped: the gallery holds 12 and there are more clean views than slots.
Slide 02 is the client's title card and is never extracted.

office-floor-plan.alt: Rendered first-floor plan of a long narrow office: cabins along one wall, workstation banks, meeting rooms and a dining hall at one end
office-floor-plan.caption: The first floor end to end: leadership and meetings, then the workstation bays, then dining and the kitchen.

materials-mood-board.note: no client mark; the connector sketches are generic linework
materials-mood-board.alt: Material mood board with grey and green stone samples, sage, mauve and taupe laminates and black and satin metal trims
materials-mood-board.caption: The palette: sage and olive, mauve and cappuccino, green and grey Kota stone, black steel and satin metal.

reception-and-arrival.note: no client mark; product display wall carries no lettering
reception-and-arrival.alt: Ground-floor reception with a sage-fronted desk, a lit product display wall under the stair and a lounge of tan armchairs
reception-and-arrival.caption: Ground-floor arrival: reception desk, product display under the stair, and a waiting lounge. Indicative viewpoint.

first-floor-waiting.note: client wordmark on the olive mural wall, patched with clean wall sampled directly above
first-floor-waiting.alt: First-floor waiting area with green and beige sofas in front of an olive mural wall of engineering line drawings
first-floor-waiting.caption: First-floor waiting at the top of the stair, outside the boardroom door. Indicative viewpoint.

boardroom.alt: Boardroom with a long table in tan leather chairs, a backlit screen wall, frosted glass partition and windows onto trees
boardroom.caption: The boardroom, set in a green Kota border and reached through its own lobby. Indicative viewpoint.

leadership-cabin.note: no client mark; CABIN-01 is room signage
leadership-cabin.alt: Private cabin with a sage desk, tan executive chair, two visitor chairs and a frosted glass door
leadership-cabin.caption: A leadership cabin: desk, two visitor chairs and a full run of storage. Indicative viewpoint.

open-plan-workstations.note: large blue client wordmark on the left feature wall, removed by inpaint: the blue letter pixels are masked and rebuilt from the wall above and below each column, which keeps the wall gradient and the niche edge
open-plan-workstations.alt: Long open-plan office with rows of workstations, planter-topped storage, striped grey and green floor and exposed steel roof
open-plan-workstations.caption: The main workstation bay under the exposed steel roof, with planters on the storage spine. Indicative viewpoint.

team-cubicles.note: client wordmark and emblem on the beige mural wall, patched with wall sampled directly below
team-cubicles.alt: Two-person team cubicles with sage panels and visitor chairs below a mural of engine line drawings
team-cubicles.caption: Team cubicles for managers who need a visitor chair but not a door. Indicative viewpoint.

war-room.note: no client mark; the screen shows a generic exploded component
war-room.alt: War room with a sage table for six, whiteboards on both side walls and a screen on a mauve wall
war-room.caption: The war room: whiteboards on two walls, built for the daily review. Indicative viewpoint.

informal-discussion-area.alt: Informal discussion area with an L-shaped sofa, air hockey and foosball tables in front of a mauve mural wall
informal-discussion-area.caption: The informal discussion zone between the work floor and dining. Indicative viewpoint.

staff-dining-hall.note: client wordmark on the olive mural wall at left, removed by inpaint: the cream letter pixels are masked and rebuilt from the wall above and below each column
staff-dining-hall.alt: Long staff dining hall with rows of four-seat tables in mauve and beige chairs under pendant lights and an exposed steel roof
staff-dining-hall.caption: The staff dining hall, with the servery at the far end. Indicative viewpoint.

kitchen-pre-preparation.alt: Stainless steel kitchen pre-preparation area with a chapati machine, dough kneader, worktops and floor drains
kitchen-pre-preparation.caption: Pre-preparation and landing, beside the service stair so deliveries never cross the dining hall. Indicative viewpoint.

cabin-display-board.note: DROPPED. Client wordmark and tagline on the display board, sitting against the board's top edge; no room to patch cleanly, and the gallery is full.

handwash-mural.note: DROPPED. Client wordmark on three uniforms in the mural and their reflections in the mirror; gallery is full.

central-stair-approach.note: DROPPED. Large client wordmark on the stair-core wall; gallery is full.
